PROF5000.description: This unit is designed to provide visiting academic staff with an overview of Australian higher education teaching and learning practices and the Australian higher education system. The unit may form a component of professional development for academic staff visiting the University from international partner institutions. The unit provides a forum for discussion and reflection on comparisons between the educational environments encountered at this University and the academic's home country.
PROF5000.outcomes: Students are able to (1) evaluate the applicability of using learning technologies in different educational environments; (2) compare approaches and administrative practices in curriculum design between Australia and their home country; and (3) synthesise alternative teaching and learning practices for implementation in their home university.
PROF5000.assessment:
Indicative assessments in this unit are as follows: (1) participation; (2) reflective journal; and (3) presentation. Further information is available in the unit outline.



This unit is assessed on an ungraded pass/ungraded failed basis. All assessment items must be successfully completed.

Student may be offered supplementary assessment in this unit if they meet the eligibility criteria.
PROF5000.contactHours: workshops: 10 x 1-3 hours plus participation in research and educational seminars as available throughout the semester of study
